crawl.note: First full crawl 2026-11-24. The site is English (no language switcher). robots.txt on www.aub.com.ph returns HTTP 200 with an empty body, so there are no Disallow rules. sitemap.xml also returns an empty HTTP 200 body. The homepage Credit Cards menu and slider point at https://online.aub.ph/creditcards, which is not in official_domains. The official path https://www.aub.com.ph/creditcards/ returns HTTP 302 to that same host and was not read. The no-slash path https://www.aub.com.ph/creditcards returned HTTP 503 in one session. No card product pages remain on aub.com.ph, so 0 cards were handed in. NEWS and Updates at /announce lists five bank notices (branch hours and earnings or capital news); none is a credit-card offer, so 0 offers were handed in. Prepaid products (HelloMoney, Hello Pag-IBIG, RediMoney/Card Inquiry) were not handed in. listing_complete is false. Please consider adding online.aub.ph if that host is accepted as official.
The official cards page also links to https://www2.bpi.com.ph/cards/pq/landing and to https://www.banko.com.ph/ for BanKo. Those hosts are not in official_domains.
Offer links also point at offers.hsbc.com.ph and www.homeandaway.hsbc.com, which are not in official_domains.

The official homepage states Apply for a credit card and links to https://apply.metrobank.com.ph/creditcard. That host is not in official_domains. No on-host card listing URL was found on the homepage.

Real-Chrome mode reached the official cards catalogue, which lists Credit, Debit and Prepaid categories and names PNB Credit Cards and the PNB-PAL Mabuhay Miles Mastercard Credit Card. The fetcher classed the homepage and catalogue captcha because the HTML includes a reCAPTCHA v3 script and badge; the public catalogue text was present and was used. No challenge was interacted with. The cards page links to https://www.pnb.com.ph/promos; this run did not return readable promo listing text.
The official site has a RCBC Credit Cards link to https://rcbccredit.com/, which is not in official_domains. The listing was not read.
